### 2026-10-05 — October 5th: Intro

**2h**

October 5th: Intro
First day of working on the Half Life!!!

Started my session by going through all the tutorials and did all the preferences and stuff like that. Read through journal examples. Then go to the project choosing part. I first thought of choosing my own project first, so I went in the internet to search for a project idea to inspire me. I was searching for something like a desktop pet and then realized Starbie was the thing I wanted to do. 15 minute down the drain great.

Read through the github page of Starbie tutorial

and got excited for my week.
